# Companion UI reference inputs

These immutable upstream files are engineering reference inputs. They are not imported into the production application yet. Preserve each original MIT copyright and permission notice with any copied or adapted code.

Meetily Community is the primary recording/meeting workflow reference. Its meeting detail split view, narrow-screen tabs, independent transcript/summary tools, neutral surfaces and clear sidebar are the relevant parts. Its proprietary Pro product, brand, analytics, onboarding, account, backend and model services are outside this adoption.

shadcn/ui is the component and layout reference: consistent neutral tokens, sidebar/list hierarchy, compact toolbars and accessible controls. It is not a second competing visual style.

Production integration must retain Companion recording identities, raw audio/transcript, saved edits, source links, background sync, privacy and export/recovery behavior. It must be validated with the actual public meeting results, including failures, rather than prewritten clean sample text. No new native package is justified by pinning these references alone.
